description:
Als Coach unterstützt du die Mitarbeitenden der Generalagentur gezielt in ihrer fachlichen und verkäuferischen Entwicklung Du führst Produkte- und Verkaufsschulungen durch, stellts Qualitätsstandards sicher und begleitest Kundenberater/innen in der Vorsorgeakquise Du begleitest Kundenberater aktiv im Verkaufsprozess – von der Vorbereitung bis zum Abschluss Du berätst unsere Privatkundschaft umfassend im Bereich Vorsorge und findest individuelle Lösungen Bestehende Kundenbeziehungen entwickelst du weiter durch gezieltes Cross- und Upselling Du erstellst Vorsorgekampagnen, übernimmst den Lead im Partneraufbau und unterstützt die GA in der strategischen Weiterentwicklung

Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). The company offers a wide range of insurance and pension products for individuals and businesses across Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: In qualità di coach, supporti in modo mirato i dipendenti dell'agenzia generale nel loro sviluppo professionale e di vendita Conduci corsi di formazione sui prodotti e sulle vendite, garantisci gli standard di qualità e accompagni i consulenti alla clientela nell'acquisizione previdenziale Accompagni attivamente i consulenti alla clientela nel processo di vendita, dalla preparazione alla conclusione Consiglierai la nostra clientela privata in modo completo nel campo della previdenza e troverai soluzioni individuali Continuerai a sviluppare le relazioni con i clienti esistenti attraverso il cross- e l'upselling mirato Creerai campagne previdenziali, assumerai il ruolo di lead nella costruzione dei partner e supporterai l'AG nell'ulteriore sviluppo strategico Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). La società offre una vasta gamma di prodotti assicurativi e pensionistici per gli individui e le imprese in tutta la Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: As a coach, you specifically support the employees of the general agency in their professional and sales development You carry out product and sales training, ensure quality standards and accompany client advisors in the acquisition of pension funds You actively accompany client advisors in the sales process – from preparation to completion You advise our private clients comprehensively in the field of pension funds and find individual solutions You further develop existing client relationships through targeted cross-selling and upselling You create pension campaigns, take over the lead in partner development and support the GA in the strategic further development Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). The company offers a wide range of insurance and pension products for individuals and businesses across Switzerland.
